Good progress - the first integer (j=180) decodes correctly with the fixed encoder. But Step 99 showed the full decompression produces 0 bytes output, not an "incomplete test." 

The 81-byte file has enough data to read j=180, but you need to verify:
1. Do all 180 operations decode without running out of input?
2. What do those operations actually do (back-refs vs literals, what values)?
3. Why does the output buffer remain empty?

Run the full decomp with detailed tracing of the operation loop to see where output generation fails.
</context_for_action>
